title: 8 Signs You're Becoming a Man Who Runs His Life, Not His Sin
caption:
One of these isn't willpower.

You can sit with an urge without obeying it. You keep a promise you made to no one but yourself. You do the hard thing before you feel like it. You'd make the same choice with or without an audience.

The gap between want and act is where your freedom lives. What you do alone is who you actually are.

#faith #selfcontrol #christianmen #manofgod #discipline
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
